title: Verified Source Cards Batch 001
mission: Create the first proof layer above source routes: official source locations verified, record contents still pending classification.
boundary: A verified source card confirms that an official or primary source route exists and is relevant to a tracker lane. It does not verify the full contents of the record until the record is pulled, dated, summarized and classified into a Verified Record Card.

cards.whatThisProves: There is an official SEC EDGAR route for Tesla filings that can support public-company filing checks for business segments, risk disclosures and governance context.
cards.whatItDoesNotProve: It does not prove the content of any specific Tesla annual report until a filing is selected and classified.
cards.nextRecord: Latest Tesla annual report and risk factor sections.
